sections.heading: Where IGCSE marks actually go missing
paragraphs: Marked scripts fail in patterns, and after enough of them the patterns become predictable. The first and largest is the command term. Every question tells the candidate what kind of answer earns the marks, and the words are not interchangeable: state wants a fact, describe wants what happens, explain wants why it happens, compare wants both sides in the same sentence, and evaluate wants a judgement with a reason. A student who writes a good description where an explanation was asked for can lose almost every mark on the question while demonstrating real understanding.

The second is method. On multi-step questions the marks are distributed across the working, not held at the answer, which means a correct final figure with nothing above it scores a fraction of what it should. The habit of writing a line of working per step has to be trained, usually against resistance, because students who can do the arithmetic in their heads see it as a waste of time. It is the single cheapest grade improvement available in any mathematics or physics paper.

The third cluster is mechanical: units, significant figures, state symbols, unbalanced equations, axes without labels, graphs plotted to the wrong scale. These are not understanding failures at all. They are the marks examiners describe as given away, and a tutor can usually remove most of them in two or three sessions by marking the student's own work in front of them rather than talking about it in the abstract.
bullets: Command terms decide the shape of the answer and therefore the mark
Method marks live in the working, not in the final answer
Units, significant figures and state symbols are marks, not pedantry
Most of these are diagnosable from one marked script in one session

sections.heading: Mathematics 0580 and 4MA1: the non-calculator paper and the method lines
paragraphs: Cambridge mathematics now gives each tier a non-calculator paper and a calculator paper of equal weight. That change caught out a generation of candidates who had done every piece of practice with a calculator to hand, and it is still the most common reason a confident student underperforms in this subject. Fraction arithmetic, surds, index laws, standard form and mental estimation all have to be fluent rather than merely understood, because there is no device to fall back on.

Pearson Edexcel 4MA1 keeps two calculator papers at the entered tier, which makes it a different examination requiring different preparation. A tutor who assumes the wrong board will spend an hour rehearsing the wrong thing, which is why the statement of entry matters more than the subject name. The tier matters as much: Core and Foundation entries cap the grade available, and that decision is the school's and is taken months before the series.

The loss that spans both boards is method. A long question carries most of its marks in the working, and a student who presents a final answer alone forfeits them whether the answer is right or wrong. Three other patterns recur: rounding too early and carrying the error through, failing to answer in the units the question asked for, and abandoning a question after one attempt instead of writing down the approach for the method marks available. That last habit is worth training on its own, because a part-written attempt at a hard question frequently earns more than a blank space earns on an easy one.
bullets: Confirm the board and tier from the statement of entry before anything else
Non-calculator fluency is examined, not assumed, in current Cambridge papers
One line of working per step, every time, even when it feels unnecessary
Round at the end; carrying a rounded figure through costs accuracy marks

sections.heading: The sciences: the practical component is the quietest loss of all
paragraphs: In Cambridge sciences the practical component carries roughly a fifth of the grade, taken either as a practical test or as the alternative-to-practical written paper. It is also the component with the least rehearsal behind it, because school laboratory time is finite and because it looks, to a parent reading a report, like the part that will take care of itself. It does not. The alternative paper asks a candidate to describe apparatus, identify variables, state precautions, tabulate results, plot them and account for sources of error, all in prose.

A student who has watched demonstrations rather than performed experiments cannot produce that prose, and no amount of theory teaching supplies it. The fix is specific and quick: rehearse the written form of practical work. How to lay out a results table with units in the headings. How to choose a scale that uses most of the grid. What a precaution is, as distinct from a safety note. What counts as a source of error, as distinct from a mistake. These are learnable conventions, and they are examined every series.

Pearson Edexcel assesses the same skills through written questions inside the theory papers, so the component does not appear separately on a results slip and is even easier to overlook. For both boards the diagnostic question to a school is simple: which practical route is my child entered for, and how many past practical or alternative papers have they completed under timed conditions. If the answer to the second is none, that is where the available marks are.
bullets: Ask which practical route each science subject is entered for
Results tables, scales and graph conventions are examined content
A precaution, a source of error and a mistake are three different things
Edexcel assesses practical skills inside the theory papers rather than separately

sections.heading: English: 0500 and 0510 fail in completely different ways
paragraphs: Families treat these as one subject with two difficulty levels, and they are not. First Language English 0500 is a reading and writing qualification for students operating in English as their strongest language, and its characteristic loss is in directed writing: the task names an audience, a purpose and a form, and the candidate writes a summary of the passage instead. The reading questions reward careful re-reading and precise selection, which students rarely budget time for.

English as a Second Language 0510 and 0511 is a different examination with different failure modes, and fluency is not a defence. Candidates who speak English all day at a Saudi international school lose marks on exercise technique, on register, and above all on the summary task, where the skill being tested is selection and compression rather than expression. The two codes differ in how the speaking result is reported, which occasionally surprises families comparing certificates later.

For both, the most useful work a tutor does is unglamorous. Read the question aloud and identify audience, purpose and form before writing anything. Annotate the passage rather than reading it twice. Plan a response in the margin. Practise the summary against the word limit until compression becomes automatic. None of that is content teaching, and all of it is where the marks are. A student whose essays feel strong and whose marks are mediocre almost always has a question-reading problem rather than a writing problem, and that is diagnosable in a single session from one marked script.
bullets: Directed writing is marked on audience, purpose and form, not content recall
The summary task is the most trainable component in the ESL papers
Fluent speakers still lose marks on register and exercise technique
Annotate the passage; two unmarked readings waste the time available

sections.heading: Economics, Business and the data-response pattern
paragraphs: These subjects are marked to a visible structure, and candidates who learn the structure outperform candidates who know more. Define the term. Draw the diagram where one applies, labelled correctly, with axes named. Explain the mechanism in steps rather than asserting the outcome. Then evaluate, which means weighing at least two considerations and committing to a judgement with a reason attached. Marks are allocated against those stages, so an answer that skips one loses its marks even when the economics is sound.

The data-response question has its own discipline. The stimulus is there to be used: figures quoted back, a trend described with numbers attached, the business or economy named rather than referred to generically. In Business Studies the application marks are forfeited by any answer that could have been written without reading the case study at all, and that is the single most common script in the subject.

Evaluation is the hardest thing to teach and the most profitable. Students default either to hedging, where both sides are stated and nothing is concluded, or to assertion, where a conclusion appears without support. What the scheme wants is a judgement that depends on something: it matters more in the short run than the long run, or more for a small firm than a large one, or only if demand is price sensitive. Once a student has three or four of those conditional structures, their marks move across every paper in the subject.
bullets: Define, diagram, explain, evaluate, in that order, against the command term
Quote the stimulus; an answer that ignores it forfeits application marks
Evaluation means a judgement with a condition, not a balanced non-answer
A diagram without labelled axes earns a fraction of the marks available

sections.heading: Cambridge against Pearson Edexcel for the same subject
paragraphs: Saudi schools enter candidates with both boards, sometimes in the same year group and occasionally in the same subject department. The qualifications are comparable in standard and not interchangeable in detail: codes differ, paper structures differ, tiering differs, and practical assessment differs substantially. A family that buys support without checking which board their child sits is gambling that the differences do not matter, and in the sciences they matter a great deal.

The table sets out the comparison for the subjects that come up most often. Two columns deserve particular attention. Tiering decides the maximum grade available and is chosen by the school, so it is a conversation to have in Year 10 rather than a fact to discover on a results slip. The practical route decides which skills are examined and how, and it is the detail most often missing from the information a parent has when they ask for help.

One further point of fact, because pages written for Indian audiences get it wrong and Gulf families act on them. Cambridge also runs a February and March series, but it is available only to candidates in India, so candidates in the Kingdom sit the June series as their main one and the November series for resits and late entries. Any plan built around a spring sitting here is built on a timetable that does not exist. If a provider proposes one, it is a reliable sign that their material was written for another market and nobody checked it against the Kingdom.

sections.heading: The IGCSE year counted backwards
paragraphs: Everything above is only useful if it happens at the right distance from the papers, so here is the course in reverse. Nothing on this page names a year, because entry deadlines, holidays and term dates belong to your school and your board, and a published date goes stale. What does not change is the order: the further out a family is, the more of the grade is still available to them, and the closer they get, the narrower the set of things that can still move.

Two years out, everything is open, and the money buys foundations: algebraic fluency, scientific vocabulary and method, extended writing, the habit of showing working. One year out, content coverage and the tier conversation are the priorities, because the tier caps the grade and is decided inside the school. Two terms out, technique takes over: command terms, timing, the practical component, whole papers marked against the scheme. One term out, the work is triage, and the honest version of triage is choosing what not to cover.

The last fortnight is not a teaching window at all. It is for sleep, for the timetable, for checking the statement of entry against the papers the student thinks they are sitting, and for whole papers under timed conditions if anything at all. Families who start in that fortnight are usually buying reassurance rather than marks, and a tutor who tells them otherwise is selling something. The same money two terms earlier would have changed the result.

sections.heading: How to check a tutor knows 0620, rather than chemistry
paragraphs: Subject knowledge and syllabus knowledge are different things, and only one of them is being paid for. A chemistry graduate knows more chemistry than any IGCSE paper requires. Whether they know that 0620 wants a reagent, an observation and a conclusion in that order, that state symbols are marked, that the Extended tier reaches further into organic chemistry, and what the alternative-to-practical paper asks for, is a separate question with a separate answer.

Four questions separate the two in a trial lesson, and a parent can ask them without knowing the subject. Which papers does my child sit for this code, and what is each worth? Which topics in this syllabus produce the most lost marks, and why? Show me, on this marked script, where the marks were available and not taken. And what will you set between lessons, and how will you mark it? A specialist answers all four immediately and concretely; a generalist answers in generalities about confidence and foundations.

Marking or examining experience is worth asking about and worth putting in perspective. A tutor who has marked for a board knows how a scheme is applied, which is genuinely useful, and the claim is checkable only by asking which board, which component and when. Treat any unverifiable statistic in the same light: a provider quoting a success percentage without a sample size, a date and a method has given you a number that means nothing, and the willingness to publish it tells you something about everything else they say.
bullets: Ask which papers the code carries and what each is worth
Ask for a diagnosis from a marked script, not a general impression
Ask what is set between lessons and how it will be marked
Treat any success statistic without a sample, a date and a method as noise

sections.heading: Coursework, the alternative papers, and the line a tutor does not cross
paragraphs: Some IGCSE subjects carry a coursework or portfolio component, and others offer a coursework route as an alternative to a written paper. Where one exists, the rules are the school's and the board's, and they are strict about authorship. A tutor may teach the skills the component assesses, explain the criteria, discuss an approach, question a conclusion and give feedback on a draft the student has written. A tutor does not write the coursework, does not complete the assignment and does not produce assessed work of any kind.

The test a parent can apply is simple: if a sentence in the submitted work was composed by anyone other than the student, the work is not the student's own, and the school is obliged to treat it as malpractice. The consequences fall on the candidate, not on the tutor who crossed the line. Keeping dated drafts is a sensible precaution, because it makes authorship demonstrable if a question is ever raised, and it costs nothing.

This matters more for families whose children are heading into the Diploma, where internal assessment sits inside almost every subject and carries a far larger share of the grade. An IGCSE candidate who has had a coursework piece improved for them arrives in that system with a habit that will eventually cost them a qualification rather than a component. Several providers in this market advertise what amounts to a writing service, sometimes in careful language; the correct response to one is to stop reading.
bullets: Ask the school which components are coursework and what the rules are
A tutor teaches the criteria and the skill; the student does the writing
Keep dated drafts so authorship can be shown if it is questioned
An offer to produce assessed work is a reason to walk away from a provider

process.title: Send the code, the tier and a marked script
process.description: The useful first message is the syllabus code, the board, the tier and the most recent marked paper. From those three lines a specialist can usually name the failure mode before the first lesson, which saves a diagnostic session that would otherwise be spent discovering it.

process.title: A diagnostic on the real papers
process.description: A short first session working past questions from the exact code and tier, marked against the published scheme in front of the student. The output is a written list of where marks are being lost, ordered by how many are available, which is rarely the order a parent expects.

process.title: A free trial lesson with the proposed tutor
process.description: Taught by the specialist who would keep the slot, on something your child has already failed to follow once. Ask the four questions from the section above during it. If the match is wrong we propose another tutor rather than asking a family to persist with one that is not working.

process.title: A weekly slot and marked work between lessons
process.description: One named hour a week in Arabia Standard Time, held for the term, with work set after each session and marked before the next. Marking between lessons is what makes the hour teaching time rather than reading time, and it is where most of the useful feedback actually happens.

process.title: Reviewed against papers, not against effort
process.description: At the end of each term, progress is reported from marked work under timed conditions: which components have moved, which have not, and whether the pattern of support is still the right one. Sometimes the honest recommendation is to reduce the hours or stop.

whyPoints.title: Matched to the code, not to the subject
whyPoints.description: A tutor is proposed for 0580 Extended or 4MA1 Higher, not for mathematics. The paper structures differ between boards and the tier caps the grade, so a match made at subject level is a match made on incomplete information, and the hour pays for the wrong rehearsal.

whyPoints.title: Diagnosis from a marked script
whyPoints.description: Support starts from where marks were actually lost, which is usually command terms, method lines or the practical component rather than the topic a student says they find hard. A script tells you that in minutes; a conversation about confidence does not.

whyPoints.title: The practical component treated as examinable
whyPoints.description: Apparatus, variables, precautions, tabulation, graph conventions and sources of error are rehearsed in writing, because that is how they are examined. In Cambridge sciences this component carries a meaningful share of the grade and is routinely the least practised part of the course.

whyPoints.title: Correct on the series a Saudi candidate can enter
whyPoints.description: Candidates here sit June and November. Cambridge's February and March series is available only to candidates in India, and material written for Indian audiences circulates widely in the Gulf. A plan built on the wrong series costs a family a year.

whyPoints.title: A fixed line on assessed work
whyPoints.description: A tutor teaches the criteria and gives feedback on a student's own draft, and never produces coursework. The line is stated before the first lesson because the consequence of crossing it falls on the candidate. Dated drafts are kept so authorship can be demonstrated.

faqs.question: Which topics in Cambridge Mathematics 0580 most often need teaching from outside school?
faqs.answer: Four recur. Algebraic manipulation, because the whole paper assumes it and a weakness there surfaces everywhere. Non-calculator arithmetic including fractions, surds, indices and standard form, now that each tier carries a paper without a calculator. Trigonometry beyond the right-angled triangle, particularly the sine and cosine rules applied to a problem rather than a diagram. And the multi-step problem, where the difficulty is deciding what to do first rather than performing any individual step. A tutor can diagnose which of the four is the issue from one marked past paper.

faqs.question: Why do Physics 0625 candidates lose marks on the six-mark extended-response question?
faqs.answer: Because they write a list of true statements instead of a connected explanation. The mark scheme awards a chain of linked reasoning, where each step follows from the previous one and the final statement answers the question asked. A candidate who writes four correct facts about current and resistance in no particular order collects far fewer marks than one who writes three statements that follow each other. The fix is structural: identify what the question wants to be true at the end, then write the steps that get there, in order.

faqs.question: What is the most common error on the Chemistry 0620 qualitative analysis questions?
faqs.answer: Giving the conclusion without the evidence. The scheme wants the reagent added, the observation that followed, and only then the identification: add sodium hydroxide solution, a green precipitate forms, therefore iron two ions are present. Candidates who have learned the results as a table write only the identification and lose most of the available marks. The second common error is vague observation language, where a candidate writes that a precipitate formed without stating its colour, or describes a solution as changing without saying to what.

faqs.question: Which Biology 0610 definitions are marked most strictly, and how should they be learned?
faqs.answer: The transport definitions are the strictest: osmosis, diffusion and active transport are marked against specific wording, including the direction of movement, what is moving, the role of a partially permeable membrane and whether energy is required. Enzyme and respiration definitions follow. Learning them by paraphrase does not work, because the examiner is checking for the required elements rather than for understanding in general. The efficient method is to learn each definition as a short list of required components and then write it out from that list until it is automatic.

faqs.question: How can a student prepare for the 0625 alternative-to-practical paper without a laboratory?
faqs.answer: Entirely on paper, which is the point of the component. The examinable skills are written ones: naming apparatus, identifying the independent, dependent and controlled variables, stating precautions that improve reliability, drawing a results table with units in the headings, choosing a graph scale that uses most of the grid, plotting accurately, drawing a line of best fit, and distinguishing a source of error from a mistake. Working through past alternative papers and marking them against the scheme builds all of it. The practical experience helps, but its absence does not prevent the marks.

faqs.question: Where does weak Year 9 algebra show up in Additional Mathematics 0606?
faqs.answer: Immediately and everywhere. 0606 assumes fluent manipulation and then builds calculus, logarithms, trigonometric identities and series on top of it, so a student who hesitates over rearranging an equation runs out of time rather than out of understanding. The symptom is usually described as finding calculus hard, when the actual failure is three lines earlier in the algebra. A tutor should test the algebra first in any 0606 diagnostic, because repairing it is faster and changes more marks than teaching the topic the student named.

faqs.question: What does the First Language English 0500 directed-writing task actually reward?
faqs.answer: Writing for the audience, purpose and form the question names, using material from the passage rather than reproducing it. Candidates lose marks by summarising the text, by writing in a register that does not match the named form, and by ignoring the instruction about who the writing is for. The reading marks within the task depend on selecting relevant material and reshaping it, not on quoting it. The most effective habit is to underline the audience, the purpose and the form before writing a single sentence, every time.

faqs.question: Why do fluent English speakers still lose marks on Cambridge 0510?
faqs.answer: Because fluency is not what is being tested. The paper assesses exercise technique, accuracy of selection, register control and above all summary writing, where the skill is compression against a word limit. A student who speaks English all day may write more than the task allows, answer in conversational register where a formal one was required, or lift sentences from the passage where the task wanted reformulation. These are trainable within a few sessions, and they are usually the whole gap between a good grade and a very good one.

faqs.question: How do Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel differ for IGCSE mathematics specifically?
faqs.answer: In structure rather than standard. Current Cambridge 0580 gives each tier a non-calculator paper and a calculator paper of equal weight, while Edexcel 4MA1 sets two calculator papers at the entered tier. The tier names differ too: Core and Extended for Cambridge, Foundation and Higher for Edexcel, with the lower tier capping the grade on both. Topic sequencing and question style differ enough that preparation is not transferable in detail. Check which board and tier appear on the statement of entry before buying support for the subject.

faqs.question: What should I ask an IGCSE tutor in a trial lesson, and what does a good answer sound like?
faqs.answer: Ask four things. Which papers does this code carry and what is each worth. Which topics in this syllabus lose candidates the most marks, and why. Looking at this marked script, where were marks available and not taken. And what will you set between lessons, and how will you mark it. A specialist answers all four concretely and in syllabus language. A generalist answers with reassurance about confidence and foundations, which may be sincere and tells you nothing about whether they know the paper your child is sitting.

faqs.question: How do I verify that a tutor knows the 0620 syllabus rather than chemistry in general?
faqs.answer: Ask syllabus-specific questions a graduate could not answer from subject knowledge alone. What does the Extended tier add to the organic chemistry content. What is the practical component worth and what does the alternative paper ask for. What order does the scheme want in a qualitative analysis answer. Which calculations appear most often and what is the usual error in them. A tutor who teaches the code answers immediately; one who teaches the subject hesitates or generalises. The same test works for any syllabus, which makes it useful to a parent who does not know the subject.

faqs.question: Does marking or examining experience matter at IGCSE level, and how would I check the claim?
faqs.answer: It matters for technique more than for content. A tutor who has applied a mark scheme knows how marks are awarded and withheld, which is exactly the knowledge that recovers the losses described on this page. The claim is checkable by asking which board, which qualification, which component and when, and a genuine answer is specific. Treat it as one useful signal rather than a requirement: an experienced classroom teacher who marks student work rigorously against published schemes produces much the same benefit.

faqs.question: What happens if an IGCSE tutor turns out to be the wrong match after two lessons?
faqs.answer: Say so, and we propose a different specialist. A mismatch at this level is usually not about competence: a tutor can know 0580 thoroughly and still not suit a particular student's pace or temperament, and persisting with it wastes a term. The practical signals are a student who cannot say what the last lesson covered, work that is not being set or marked, or sessions that drift into general chat about school. None of those is a reason to abandon tutoring; all of them are reasons to change tutor early rather than late.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with an IGCSE coursework or portfolio component?
faqs.answer: With the skills, the criteria and feedback on the student's own draft, yes. A tutor may explain how the component is assessed, discuss an approach, question the reasoning and point out where a draft does not meet a criterion. A tutor does not write the coursework and does not produce any part of the submitted work. Ask the school first what external help its own rules permit for that component, because schools set limits on the amount of formal feedback a supervisor may give, and those limits apply regardless of who is paid.

faqs.question: How do I know my child's IGCSE coursework is genuinely their own work?
faqs.answer: Keep the drafts, dated, and read them. A piece that improves gradually across versions in the student's own voice looks entirely different from one that arrives finished. Ask your child to explain a paragraph to you without the document open; authorship is obvious within a minute. Schools also use similarity software, which catches copied text and misses text written to order, so a parent's own reading is the better check. The point is not suspicion. It is that the consequence of malpractice falls on the candidate alone.

faqs.question: Our child moves from IGCSE into the Diploma next year — what changes about what a tutor may do?
faqs.answer: The stakes rise, because internal assessment sits inside almost every Diploma subject and carries a large share of each grade, and the Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge add their own requirements. The authorship rule is identical but enforced more heavily, and the coordinator sets limits on how much formal feedback a supervisor may give on a draft. A student who has had work improved for them at IGCSE level arrives with a habit that risks a qualification rather than a component. Establish the boundary before DP1 begins.

igcse-online-tutor.closingHeading: Send a marked paper and the syllabus code
igcse-online-tutor.closingBody: The quickest way to a useful answer is the code, the tier, the board and the most recent marked script. From those we can usually name where the marks are going before anyone teaches a lesson, and say whether a specialist in that exact paper is free in a slot that works with your school week. If nobody suitable is available we will tell you rather than offering a generalist. The trial lesson is free and taught by the proposed tutor. Lessons are one-to-one and delivered online over live video, pinned to Arabia Standard Time.

igcse-private-tutor.tutorsIntro: The tutors below teach named IGCSE syllabuses rather than school subjects in general. A Cambridge 0580 Extended candidate, a 0580 Core candidate and a Pearson 4MA1 Higher candidate are sitting different papers with different ceilings, so the match is made on the entry the school has registered, not on the year group.

intro.heading: The IGCSE does not usually fail students on content
paragraphs: An IGCSE is a two-year course examined almost entirely by written paper, and the ways it goes wrong are mechanical enough to name. The first is the entry itself. Several subjects are tiered: Cambridge Mathematics runs as Core or Extended, Pearson Edexcel Mathematics A as Foundation or Higher, and the tier a school enters a student for sets the highest grade available before any teaching happens. Families are rarely shown that decision in writing, and by the time a mock paper reveals it the entry window may have closed.

The second failure is algebra, and it hides everywhere. A student who cannot rearrange confidently loses marks in geometry, in statistics, in physics and in chemistry calculations, and every one of those losses looks like a weakness in the topic rather than in the skill. Buying more topic teaching treats the symptom. The third is the mark scheme: method marks are awarded for working that was done in the student's head, units are dropped, and a four-mark question is answered as though it were worth one. The fourth is practical work, where a student with limited laboratory access is asked on paper to describe a method precisely enough to be credited for it.

The fifth is reading. Both boards examine comprehension and summary technique in their English papers, and both reward writing that matches a given text type and audience. Students who speak English fluently often lose marks because the answer was written in the wrong register or because a summary included detail the question did not ask for. None of that is a language deficiency; it is examination technique, and it is among the most teachable things on any IGCSE paper.

That diagnosis determines what support is worth buying, which is the second half of this page. Rates in the Kingdom are advertised rather than regulated. Budget platforms market IGCSE one-to-one from as little as SAR 35 an hour, general non-specialist online tutoring starts from around SAR 55, tutor-marketplace guides put senior-school examination subjects at 200 and above, and tutoring companies list IB subject work from about SAR 180. Those are vendors describing their own prices. They are not a market average, and none of them is what IB Gram charges. The spread tells a family that the word 'tutor' covers very different purchases.

IB Gram is an independent tutor-matching platform, not approved by, accredited by or partnered with Cambridge, Pearson, the IB, the Ministry of Education or ETEC. Lessons for families in the Kingdom are delivered online, one-to-one, over live video. IB Gram does not send a tutor to a Saudi address; home visits in Saudi Arabia are not a service we sell, and in-home teaching is offered only in India. For an IGCSE subject that a school is not teaching in full, that is the difference between a specialist in the exact syllabus and the nearest available person with a free evening.
bullets: Tiered entry on several subjects fixes the grade ceiling before teaching starts
Algebraic weakness shows up as a topic problem in four different subjects
Method marks reward written working, not correct answers arrived at silently
Practical and alternative-to-practical papers punish vague method writing
Advertised rates in this market run from about SAR 35 to above SAR 200 an hour

igcse-private-tutor.programmesIntro: Four stages matter around an IGCSE: what feeds into it, the two boards that examine it, and what it feeds into. The entry decisions that cost the most are made at the joins between them.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE
programmes.description: Subject-by-subject courses examined by written paper, each with a syllabus code and its own paper structure. Several subjects offer Core and Extended routes with different papers and different grade ceilings. A handful carry coursework or a practical component that the school marks and Cambridge moderates; most do not.
programmes.countryNote: The most widely taken international route in the Kingdom, partly because it needs fewer specialist staff than a full Diploma and can be examined through an examination centre. That also makes it the route where tier and code decisions are most often made quietly, so ask for both in writing well before entries are made.

programmes.name: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE
programmes.description: The same age group and a similar level of demand, with a different paper architecture. Most subjects are examined entirely by written paper with no coursework element, tiering on mathematics runs as Foundation and Higher, and the grading scale reported is numerical rather than lettered.
programmes.countryNote: Common in British-curriculum schools in the Kingdom, and sometimes chosen precisely because fully examined subjects need no laboratory or coursework moderation. A student can hold both boards on one transcript if the school enters them separately, which is normal and needs explaining to universities only rarely.

programmes.name: The years that feed in
programmes.description: Cambridge Lower Secondary, the Middle Years Programme and school-designed English-medium curricula all feed into IGCSE. What matters is not the label but three skills: algebraic fluency, extended written explanation in English, and the habit of reading a question before answering it.
programmes.countryNote: This is where the cheapest intervention in the whole system sits, and where almost nobody buys one, because nothing looks wrong yet. A student who arrives in Grade 9 fluent in algebra and able to write a paragraph of reasoned explanation will find every IGCSE subject easier than a classmate who is stronger on content.

programmes.name: What IGCSE feeds into
programmes.description: The IB Diploma, Cambridge International AS and A Level, or a national-curriculum pathway. Each expects something different from an IGCSE record: subject grades at a level that supports Higher Level or A Level study, and in mathematics the depth that Additional Mathematics provides and the standard course does not.
programmes.countryNote: The decision that gets made too late in the Kingdom is mathematics. A student heading for Higher Level Analysis and Approaches or A Level Mathematics benefits from Additional Mathematics beforehand, and that choice has to be made in Grade 9, not after the results arrive.

igcse-private-tutor.subjectsIntro: At IGCSE the code matters as much as the subject name, because two students in one classroom can be entered for different papers. Each note below names where the marks actually go in that syllabus.

subjects.name: Mathematics (Cambridge 0580)
subjects.description: Two tiers, two sets of papers, two ceilings. Marks are lost in rearrangement and indices long before they are lost in a topic, and in questions where the working was done mentally and never written. Students who write every line collect method marks they would otherwise throw away on a correct answer.

subjects.name: Mathematics A (Pearson 4MA1)
subjects.description: Foundation and Higher tiers with different ceilings, examined across two papers with a calculator permitted. Question wording differs from Cambridge's in style rather than in difficulty, which matters for a student who has practised only one board's past papers and meets the other in the hall.

subjects.name: Additional Mathematics (Cambridge 0606)
subjects.description: Taken alongside 0580 by students heading for a mathematics-heavy sixth form. It brings in calculus, trigonometric identities and function work early, and it is the single best preparation for Higher Level Analysis and Approaches or A Level Mathematics. Students underestimate the pace, not the difficulty.

subjects.name: Physics (Cambridge 0625, Pearson 4PH1)
subjects.levels: Core or Extended, and single tier
subjects.description: Formula recall is the easy part. Marks go on unit handling, rearrangement under time pressure, and the practical or alternative-to-practical paper, where answers have to describe a method, a control and a source of error precisely enough for an examiner to credit them.

subjects.name: Chemistry (Cambridge 0620, Pearson 4CH1)
subjects.levels: Core or Extended, and single tier
subjects.description: Moles calculations, ionic equations and the qualitative analysis tests account for a disproportionate share of lost marks. Learning the tests for gases and ions properly, and laying every calculation out in steps rather than in one line, moves a grade without a single new topic.

subjects.name: Biology (Cambridge 0610, Pearson 4BI1)
subjects.levels: Core or Extended, and single tier
subjects.description: Large content, precise marking. Definitions are credited against specific wording, and extended answers are judged against the command term rather than against general accuracy. Diagram labelling and data interpretation are the fastest recoverable marks for a student who already knows the material.

subjects.name: Co-ordinated and Combined Sciences (Cambridge 0654 and 0653)
subjects.description: Routes that cover all three sciences in less curriculum time, often chosen where a school cannot staff three separate subjects. Breadth is the difficulty: a student meets every major topic once with little room to consolidate, so sequencing and revision design matter more here than anywhere else.

subjects.name: First Language English (Cambridge 0500)
subjects.description: Directed writing and reading analysis carry the paper. Strong writers lose marks by writing well in the wrong register, or by analysing a passage in general terms instead of quoting a specific choice and explaining its effect. Structure an examiner can see at a glance is worth more than elegance.

subjects.name: English as a Second Language (Cambridge 0510 and 0511)
subjects.levels: Single route, with and without count-in speaking
subjects.description: The two codes differ in how speaking is treated, which is a school decision parents are rarely shown. Marks turn on comprehension technique and on summary writing, where the discipline is leaving out everything the question did not ask for. It is the most teachable component on the paper.

subjects.name: Economics and Business Studies (Cambridge 0455 and 0450)
subjects.description: Both reward definitions used precisely and applied to the case material in front of the student. The commonest loss is an answer that defines a term correctly, explains it well, and never returns to the business or market the question actually named.

subjects.name: Computer Science and ICT (Cambridge 0478 and 0417)
subjects.description: Computer Science is examined on paper, which catches out students who code comfortably: pseudocode conventions, trace tables and written explanations of algorithms carry the marks. ICT splits between a written paper and practical tasks assessed under controlled conditions.

subjects.name: Geography and History (Cambridge 0460 and 0470)
subjects.description: Source and data handling decide these papers. Geography rewards case-study detail used as evidence rather than recited, and History rewards an argument built from sources with a stated judgement. Both punish long answers that narrate rather than argue.

igcse-private-tutor.regionsTitle: Where IGCSE candidates sit in the Kingdom, and what the local market offers
igcse-private-tutor.regionsIntro: IGCSE provision is spread more widely across Saudi Arabia than Diploma provision, because a school can enter candidates for written papers without staffing a full international programme. What differs by city is depth: how many subjects are genuinely taught, and by specialists.

regions.name: Riyadh
regions.note: The widest choice of British and international schools in the Kingdom, and an hour of traffic from one side to the other. Even in Riyadh, families source Additional Mathematics and the separate sciences from outside more often than any other subjects, because those are the hardest classes to fill.

regions.name: Jeddah
regions.note: Cambridge provision is long established along the coastal spine running north from the historic centre to Obhur. The practical constraint is the length of the school run: a lesson that depends on a parent completing a cross-city drive first is a lesson that gets cancelled twice a term.

regions.name: Al Khobar, Dammam and Dhahran
regions.note: British-curriculum schooling is well rooted here and the three cities behave as one school market, with families living in one and schooling in another. The King Fahd Causeway to Bahrain adds a further option that some families use for schooling or for family logistics.

regions.name: Jubail and Yanbu
regions.note: Industrial cities with international schooling built around the plants. Candidate numbers are small, so a school may enter for a double-award science rather than three separate ones. That makes the separate sciences a common outside request for students aiming at a science-heavy sixth form.

regions.name: Al Ahsa and Qatif
regions.note: Al Ahsa sits roughly ninety minutes inland from the Eastern Province cluster, with Qatif on the coast to the north of Dammam. Distance rather than quality is the constraint: a weekly evening arrangement that depends on somebody driving rarely survives a whole school year.

regions.name: Makkah and Taif
regions.note: Makkah lies about 80km east of Jeddah and Taif climbs into the hills beyond. Families here often look west for international schooling, and the city's visitor seasons change traffic patterns enough that a fixed online slot holds better than any travelling arrangement.

regions.name: Madinah
regions.note: A growing private sector with limited international provision at the upper secondary stage, so IGCSE is frequently the route a family takes. Jeddah is around two hours away on the Haramain line, which some families use for schooling and most would rather not use weekly.

regions.name: Tabuk, NEOM and AlUla
regions.note: The north-west sees a steady flow of relocating families, and students arrive part-way through a two-year course with a different board behind them. An audit of what has been covered against the published syllabus is more useful here than any amount of general revision.

regions.name: Abha and Khamis Mushait
regions.note: Two 'Asir cities about 25km apart at altitude, sharing a catchment. The nearest specialist in a given subject may be hundreds of kilometres away, which is the plainest case for teaching online rather than an argument about technology.

regions.name: Buraidah, Ha'il, Jazan and Najran
regions.note: Provincial cities where international-curriculum teaching is thin and candidates are sometimes entered through a centre rather than taught a full course in school. Enquiries from here are often about covering a whole syllabus, which needs a checklist and twice-weekly sessions from the start.

schoolClusters.city: Jeddah, Thuwal and the western region
schoolClusters.note: The western region carries both Cambridge and IB provision, with several long-established international schools serving expatriate communities and The KAUST School on the research campus at Thuwal, north of the city. Students we support attend schools including these; named here as context only.

British and Cambridge curricula are well established around Dhahran, and the International Schools Group runs several campuses across the province, not all of which offer the same programmes. Confirm the board and the subject list with the school rather than assuming consistency across a group.

The capital holds the Kingdom's deepest international school market, with IB World Schools listed in directories alongside British-curriculum and bilingual schools entering Cambridge and Pearson candidates. Choice is wide enough that subject-level questions matter more here than school-level ones.

igcse-private-tutor.modesIntro: Four shapes of IGCSE support, chosen by what the diagnosis says rather than by what the calendar makes urgent. Each runs online, one-to-one, over live video on Arabia Standard Time.

modes.title: Foundation repair, usually algebra
modes.description: For the student whose weakness moves from topic to topic and never resolves. The work is diagnostic first, then direct repair of the missing skill rather than more practice in the topic where it surfaced. It is the least glamorous purchase in this market and routinely the one that moves the most marks.
bullets: A diagnostic that names a skill, not a chapter
Rearrangement, indices and manipulation drilled until automatic
Progress checked in the subjects where the weakness was showing
Usually four to ten sessions rather than a full term

modes.title: A syllabus the school is not teaching in full
modes.description: Common with Additional Mathematics, the separate sciences and less widely chosen options. This follows the published syllabus in order at twice-weekly frequency, with a checklist the family can see, and introduces past papers only once a topic is genuinely secure rather than as a substitute for teaching it.
bullets: Syllabus checklist shared at the start and ticked off openly
Two sessions a week while content is being covered
Written work set between lessons and returned marked
Past papers once a topic is secure, not before

modes.title: Paper technique before a series
modes.description: A short block for a student who knows the content and loses marks in the hall. Timed questions, then the mark scheme taken apart line by line, with a time budget per mark and a decided order for the paper. The target is the distance between what the student knows and what an examiner can award.
bullets: A time budget per mark, practised under interruption
Mark-scheme comparison in the same session as the attempt
A written list of the three errors costing the most marks
Paper order decided deliberately rather than by default

modes.title: Resit recovery for the November series
modes.description: For a candidate retaking one or two subjects after a June result. The work starts from the actual paper performance where that can be established, targets the components that failed rather than the whole course, and runs to a tighter schedule because the second series arrives quickly.
bullets: Entry and timing confirmed with the school before any teaching
Work targeted at components rather than at the whole syllabus
A realistic statement of what one series gap can recover
Weekly written work, marked, with no gaps in the schedule

sections.heading: The tier decision that sets the ceiling before teaching starts
paragraphs: Several IGCSE subjects are tiered, and tiering is not a difficulty setting. It is a different set of papers with a different highest available grade. Cambridge Mathematics 0580 runs as Core or Extended; Pearson Edexcel Mathematics A runs as Foundation or Higher; several Cambridge sciences offer Core and Extended routes within one syllabus. A student entered for the lower tier cannot reach the top grades no matter how well they are taught, and a student entered for the higher tier against weak foundations sits a paper that will expose every gap.

The decision is usually made by the school, sometimes on performance and sometimes on timetable convenience, and it is rarely communicated to parents as a decision at all. That is the first thing to establish: which tier, on what evidence, and by when can it be changed. Entry windows close months before a series, and your school's examinations officer holds the actual dates. Once entries are submitted, a tier change is an administrative matter rather than a teaching one, and it may not be possible at all.

There is an honest case for each tier. A student secure in the basics but not fluent in algebraic manipulation may well score better on the lower tier, and a solid grade there is worth more than a poor one above it, provided the family understands what doors that closes for the next stage. A sixth form or a Diploma school may require a grade that only the higher tier can produce, and some subjects at the next level assume content that only the higher tier covers. The decision should be made against what the student is aiming at next, not against this term's comfort.

What a tutor can do here is produce the evidence. Two full past papers under timed conditions on each tier give a far better picture than a teacher's impression, and that evidence is what changes a conversation with a school from an opinion into a case. If the tier is already fixed and wrong, the remaining work is to maximise what that paper can give, which is a legitimate plan rather than a consolation.

sections.heading: Cambridge and Pearson for the same subject
paragraphs: Families often discover mid-course that their child's school uses one board for mathematics and another for a science, or that a new school uses the other board entirely. The two are comparable in level and different in architecture, and the differences are worth understanding because they change what practice is useful.

Cambridge publishes subject syllabuses with four-digit codes and offers tiered routes on several of them, with a small number of subjects carrying coursework or a practical component that the school marks and Cambridge moderates. Where no laboratory is available, an alternative-to-practical written paper examines experimental skills on paper instead. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE runs most subjects as fully examined qualifications with no coursework element, which is one reason schools without laboratory capacity choose it, and it reports grades numerically rather than as letters.

The practical consequence for a student is past papers. Question style differs between the boards even where content matches, and a candidate who has practised exclusively on one board's papers can be unsettled by the other's phrasing in a hall. A tutor should be working from the papers of the board the student is actually entered for, which sounds obvious and is a question worth asking directly, because generic revision material is written for neither.

The grading scales are a second practical matter. A numerical grade and a lettered grade do not map onto each other cleanly, and a sixth form or university that states its requirement in one scale may need the other explained. Ask the school which scale appears on the certificate and keep every statement of results, because a transcript that mixes boards is normal and occasionally needs a covering explanation.

sections.heading: Algebra is the subject behind four subjects
paragraphs: If one thing explains more IGCSE underperformance than anything else, it is algebraic fluency, and the reason it goes undiagnosed is that it never presents itself as an algebra problem. It appears as weakness in geometry, because the question ends in an equation to solve. It appears in statistics, because a mean has to be rearranged out of a total. It appears in physics, because every formula needs rearranging under time pressure. It appears in chemistry, because moles work is proportion handled symbolically.

A student in that position looks inconsistent. They do well on a topic taught last week and badly on the same topic in a mixed paper, and the school's report says they need to revise more. More revision in the topic does nothing, because the topic was never the problem. The diagnosis is quick: give the student a short set of pure manipulation questions with no context at all, and watch what happens to speed and accuracy. The result is usually unambiguous within ten minutes.

The repair is dull and fast. Rearrangement, indices, fractions as algebra, expanding and factorising, and solving in more than one step, drilled until they are automatic rather than carefully reasoned each time. Automatic matters: a student who can do these things slowly will still run out of time in a paper, because the working memory spent on manipulation is not available for the actual question. Four to ten sessions usually does it, and the improvement shows up in four subjects at once.

This is also the clearest example of why a diagnosis should precede a purchase. A family who buys a term of physics teaching for a student with an algebra gap has bought the wrong thing at the right price, and will conclude that tutoring does not work. The honest version of this market says which subject to buy, not just how much it costs per hour.
bullets: Test manipulation with context removed; the result is usually obvious in ten minutes
Automatic beats careful: slow correct work still runs out of time in a paper
Repairing the skill lifts geometry, statistics, physics and chemistry together
Topic revision cannot fix a skill gap, however much of it is bought

sections.heading: Method marks, units and the working nobody wrote down
paragraphs: IGCSE mark schemes award marks for method as well as for answers, which means a student can be right and underpaid. The commonest version is arithmetic done mentally: a correct final number with two intermediate steps missing collects the answer mark and loses the method marks that were available on the way. A strong student loses more this way than a weak one, because they are the ones confident enough to skip the lines.

Units and significant figures are the second quiet loss. A physics answer with the right number and no unit is not a complete answer, and a chemistry calculation rounded at every intermediate step drifts away from the accepted range. Neither is a knowledge problem and both are habits, which means they respond to correction quickly if anyone names them. A student who has never had a paper marked against the actual mark scheme has no idea these marks exist.

The way to teach this is not to talk about it. It is to have the student attempt a question, then hand them the published mark scheme and make them mark their own answer. The first time, most students award themselves more than the scheme does and have to be shown why. The second time, they start writing lines they would previously have skipped. Three or four rounds of that changes behaviour in a way that a hundred reminders do not.

That exercise also transfers across subjects, which is what makes it good value. A student who has internalised how method marks are awarded in mathematics writes better physics answers and lays out chemistry calculations more carefully, without being taught either subject again. It is the same economy as command-term work in the Diploma: a technique fix that pays in every paper the student sits.

sections.heading: Practical papers, laboratories and what gets written down
paragraphs: Science at IGCSE assesses experimental skills, and how it does that depends on the entry. Cambridge candidates may sit a practical examination or an alternative-to-practical written paper, and Pearson examines experimental skills inside its written papers. The content is similar; the demands on a student are not. A written practical paper asks for a method described in enough detail that somebody else could follow it, a named control, a sensible range of readings and an identified source of error.

That is where students with limited laboratory access lose marks, and the loss has nothing to do with intelligence. A student who has done an experiment knows that the thermometer has to be read at eye level and that the first run is always the messy one. A student who has only read about it writes a method with the key step missing, because the key step is the one you only notice when something goes wrong in front of you.

Some of this can be taught without a laboratory, and it is worth being clear about which parts. Method writing, variable control, table and graph design, uncertainty estimation and error identification are all teachable on screen from real past-paper questions and real data sets. Manipulative skill and the judgement that comes from having spilled something cannot be taught remotely. Where the school has no practical access at all, the honest answer is that the written components can be prepared thoroughly and the rest is a limitation to plan around rather than to pretend away.

Ask the school two questions early: which practical route the student is entered for, and what access exists for whatever is required. A school entering candidates for an alternative-to-practical paper has made a sensible choice given its facilities, and the student still needs to have seen enough real apparatus to write about it convincingly.
bullets: Confirm whether the entry involves a practical examination or a written alternative
Method writing, controls, ranges and error sources are all teachable from past papers
Graph and table design is marked and is routinely untaught
Manipulative skill needs a laboratory; the written components do not
A student who has seen the apparatus writes a better method than one who has not

sections.heading: What IGCSE support costs in this market, and what the price is buying
paragraphs: Every figure here is somebody else's advertised rate, attributed to the kind of source that publishes it. There is no regulated average in the Kingdom, nothing below is what IB Gram charges, and a vendor's own marketing page is not evidence of what families actually pay. What the numbers are good for is working out whether a quote in front of you is high for a reason.

The range is enormous for what looks like the same product. Budget platforms advertise IGCSE one-to-one online from around SAR 35 an hour. General online tutoring with no subject specialism starts from about SAR 55. Tutor-marketplace guides put general private tuition for a primary child at roughly SAR 50 and senior-school examination subjects at 200 and above. Tutoring companies list IB subject tutoring from about SAR 180, rising to roughly SAR 200 to 220 for Higher Level and premium tracks, which is the band an IGCSE specialist with marking experience will be quoted against rather than the budget platform rate. International providers quoting around sixty dollars an hour introduce an exchange-rate question into a monthly budget.

What moves a number, in order: how scarce that specialist is, marking or examining experience, the level of the course, whether anybody travels, and the length of the commitment. For IGCSE specifically, scarcity is lower than at Higher Level, which is why the floor of this market is lower. The exceptions are Additional Mathematics, the separate sciences taught to Extended level, and the less widely chosen options, where the specialist pool narrows and the price moves accordingly.

Two questions convert a rate into a decision. Ask what this rate is high for, and expect a specific answer rather than a general one about quality. Then ask what the hour includes, because marking a full past paper properly takes most of an hour by itself, and a rate that includes it and a rate that does not can look identical on a price list. Across thirty sessions that difference is larger than the gap between two hourly figures.
